name: Inquiry Acknowledgement Notification to Customer
script:
# Simple Lead Acknowledgment Email Script # Trigger: After Submit on Lead DocType recipient_email = doc.get("email_id") if recipient_email: # Prepare customer name customer_name = doc.get("contact_person") or doc.get("company_name") or "Valued Customer" site_url = frappe.utils.get_url() # e.g., https://yourdomain.com logo_url = site_url + "/files/eitslogo.png" # Email subject subject = f"Thank You for Your Inquiry - Ref: {doc.name}" # Email message message = f"""

Thank You for Your Inquiry!

Dear {customer_name},

Thank you for reaching out to us. We have received your inquiry and our team will review your requirements shortly.

Your Inquiry Details:

Reference Number: {doc.name}

Company Name: {doc.get('company_name', 'Not provided')}

Contact Person: {doc.get('contact_person_name', 'Not provided')}

Email: {doc.get('email_id', 'Not provided')}

Phone: {doc.get('phone_number', 'Not provided')}

Industry: {doc.get('industry_type', 'Not specified')}

Services Required: {doc.get('services_required', 'Not specified')}

Lead Source: {doc.get('lead_source', 'Not specified')}

Lead Status: {doc.get('lead_status', 'Not specified')}

Budget Range: {doc.get('budget_range', 'Not specified')}

Timeline: {doc.get('timeline', 'Not specified')}

Priority Level: {doc.get('priority_level', 'Not specified')}

What Happens Next?

  • Our team will review your requirements within 24 hours
  • We'll prepare a customized plan based on your inputs
  • You'll receive a detailed quotation and timeline

If you have any questions, please contact us at rpoconsulting@gmail.com or call +971 0501768742.

Thank you for choosing us!

Best regards,
Your Business Development Team

""" # Send email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[recipient_email], subject=subject, message=message ) # Add comment to lead doc.add_comment("Comment", f"Acknowledgment email sent to {recipient_email}") else: frappe.log_error(f"No email found for lead: {doc.name}", "Email Missing")

name: Auto Invoice Id Generation
script:
# # This runs before inserting a new Candidate Assessment record
if not doc.invoice_id_id:
    count = frappe.db.count("Invoice") + 1
    today = frappe.utils.nowdate()  # e.g. "2025-09-09"
    doc.invoice_id = f"INV-{today}-{str(count).zfill(4)}"
doc.name=doc.invoice_id
